label: Gesture Lab, University of Oldenburg
note: sound-treated lab with a 29-loudspeaker array around the listening position (16 at ear height 1.6 m and 1.76 m away, a 6-loudspeaker ring above and one below, one overhead); README: RT30 0.17 s, EDT 0.08 s, DRR 6.9 dB; conditions: with or without a 1.2 x 1.2 m platform 0.3 m high under the HATS; the source positions follow the IR files, which store the upper ring (C.1-C.6) at 30 degrees and the lower ring (A.1-A.6) at -40 degrees elevation, not the 34 and -38 degrees of README.md and raw/lidhan_3d.spk. RIRDB measures 0.14 s at 500 Hz-1 kHz on the omni IRs (0.31 s at 125 Hz, 0.11 s at 4 kHz), below the README's broadband RT30 of 0.17 s; the README's DRR of 6.89 dB is one loudspeaker's value (analyse_ir.m measures sIR(1) in every loop step), while RIRDB's omni DRR is 4.7-8.6 dB, and 12.9 dB for the overhead loudspeaker at 0.8 m.
